sections.title: atm clear
sections.commentary: This path should mutate only message-status for normal clear or delete operations and leave hard deletion to retention cleanup policy.

sections.title: atm doctor
sections.commentary: This diagnostic flow should report config, runtime, and optional store-health failures clearly without mutating mailbox state.

sections.title: atm list
sections.commentary: This query should start from message-status, exclude deleted rows, collapse superseded rows in normal mode, and fetch only header fields for selected keys.

sections.title: atm log
sections.summary: Observability query and follow service path.
sections.commentary: This flow should stay behind the observability boundary and must not add ad hoc CLI-side file parsing.

sections.title: atm members
sections.commentary: This flow should read deterministic roster state through the team-admin boundary and surface query failures clearly.

sections.title: atm read
sections.commentary: This read path should select from message-status first, hide deleted rows in normal mode, and fetch full content only for the chosen key.

sections.title: atm ack
sections.summary: Ack-state mutation and optional reply creation.
sections.commentary: This path should mutate only status plus any explicit reply row, then run post-commit effects without changing durable truth on hook or nudge failure.

sections.title: atm send
sections.summary: Compose and persist one message, then run post-commit effects.
sections.commentary: This path should validate input, commit SQLite first, then run post-commit hooks or advisory nudges without letting any side effect outrun durable truth.

sections.title: atm teams
sections.commentary: This flow should stay in the retained team-admin surface and report config or store failures without bypassing the boundary.
